q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a gauze bandage roll?
title: Gauze bandage carbon footprint per roll
short: Add the cotton yarn per roll and its supplier figure, then weaving, bleaching and drying energy, and cutting and packing. Divide the unit's energy by rolls made, stated by width and length.

ul: Cotton yarn by weight per roll.

p: Report per roll by width and length, since material scales directly with area.

example.title: Worked example: gauze bandage unit per roll (one month)
lines: Plant total: 34,850 / 500,000 = 0.0697 kg CO2 per roll
Add cotton yarn for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
